style.toneOfVoice: A real feast for your eyes, this luxury wreath plays on dark, rich colours and jewel-tones, elevating a traditional Christmas decoration to a level of contemporary elegance that’s sure to make your home stand out from the crowd when displayed in pride of place on your front door. Our festive wreath is lovingly crafted to a stunning quality, and decked with an abundance of natural treasures, including woodland pinecones which are stained a deep wine red, and a variety of winter hedgerow leaves, from fluffy furze to sprigs of evergreen pine needles. Whether you favour a classic approach to Christmas décor, or prefer a more modern theme, this natural wreath is sure to suit your home perfectly. Plump, shining berries and delicately curled wooden petals add a stunning finishing touch to impress your guests with a welcoming feature. Dia. 30cm Size: ONE.
